findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_document_carousel" is 678 chars, far longer than this server's median (82). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, search_content, get_contact_options, get_contact_card · Private data: search_media_assets, search_documents, get_document, get_contact_options, get_document_carousel, get_contact_card · Public sink: get_contact_options, get_contact_card.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, search_content, get_contact_options, get_contact_card · Private data: search_media_assets, search_documents, get_document, get_contact_options, get_document_carousel, get_contact_card · Public sink: get_contact_options, get_contact_card

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
